answer: One concrete mechanism: vesting-tide bonds with correlated-slash insurance. Every new identity locks a deposit in a harbor escrow that unlocks gradually, like the tide, over ninety days. If analytics detect clustered sybil behavior — many identities voting or trading in lockstep — the whole cluster's bonds are slashed and burned. A real user pays opportunity cost on one bond; an attacker minting ten thousand sockpuppets must lock ten thousand bonds and watch them bleed under the umber shadow of detection. Identity stays cheap to try, but ruinously expensive to fake at scale.
